GitCode modifications: TypeScript adaptation in src/ideaGraphLayout.ts,
explicit partial-history boundaries, iterative traversal, SVG paths,
and lower-priority auxiliary stash nodes. Reference name ordering uses
Intl.Collator numeric comparison rather than IntelliJ NaturalComparator.
GitCode retains its existing color palette and independent worktree row.
Commit text uses per-row graph extents with a six-lane recommended baseline cap.
Merge text highlighting retains GitCode theme colors. Arrow ornaments use the
compact 22px reference scale independently of GitCode's 30px rows and thick lines.
Branch traversal heads exclude non-head tags. Fragment identities are retained
from the loaded unfiltered graph; hidden ancestry is projected to dotted edges.
Unknown-parent edges use neighboring-row special stubs and contribute to the
arrow-aware recommended width. Native print-layout fixtures exercise these rules.
